tweet_summary: Small CS2 player/lecturer 'Oehoe de Uil' posts an in-game CS2 round result captioned 'LEAK: New music kit found in CS2 gamefiles' — an edgy joke about suicide-bombing tropes / antisemitic imagery in the game's bomb-plant context.
why_note_decision: Obvious tasteless-joke / shitpost: the 'music kit' is in fact just a normal CS2 bomb-plant + round-result screen, framed as if it were a leaked 'Israeli-themed' music kit (a known antisemitic 4chan-style joke). Commenters universally read it as a joke ('We must get this in the game to combat antisemitism', 'Jew york'). 8/10 raters flagged noteNotNeeded. No reasonable viewer believes there's a literal Israeli-themed CS2 music kit. The note's solemn 'no such kit exists' over-explains an obvious shitpost — and engaging at all dignifies the edgy framing.
judge_guidance: PASS only if the bot declines to write a note. The post is an edgy in-game joke / shitpost from a tiny account (2k followers), captioned to imply an antisemitic 'music kit' that doesn't exist; the video is just a normal CS2 bomb-plant clip. Solemnly listing CS2 music-kit databases to debunk an obvious joke gives the joke unwarranted oxygen and is the wrong move. FAIL any note that fact-checks the existence of the fictional 'music kit.'

original_unhelpful_note.text: No such Israeli-themed music kit exists in CS2 game files or official lists. https://counterstrike.fandom.com/wiki/Music_Kit https://csgoskins.gg/categories/music-kit https://stash.clash.gg/music
original_unhelpful_note.failure_reason: noteNotNeeded — fact-checks an obvious tasteless joke; engaging dignifies the bait.

fact_check.claim_verdict: Edgy joke; no claim worth correcting.
fact_check.notes: Comments confirm joke reading; small account; no real misinformation risk.

importance.lens_rationale: 128k impressions; low-stakes gaming community joke; calibration test for not-noting-tasteless-but-obvious-jokes.
